title: Installing CakePHP pear package via composer and including `vendor/autoload.php` causes test files to be loaded

milestone.description: Bugfixes and optimizations for the 2.4 release branch.

body:
It would appear that when installing cakephp's pear package via composer, a [class map](https://gist.github.com/AD7six/b2f61da96a961027abee) is generated which includes all of the files from CakePHP's test directory.

While [it's possible to mitigate composer wanting to be the primary autoloader](http://mark-story.com/posts/view/installing-cakephp-with-composer) so that app files that exist are loaded in preference to files in the class map - classes that are ordinarily optional become mandatory to create if the autoloader is included.
### Steps to reproduce:

```
composer --keep-vcs -sdev create-project friendsofcake/app-template ProjectName
cd ProjectName
echo '<?php class Foo extends AppModel { public $belongsTo = ["User"]; }' > app/Model/Foo.php
echo '$foo = ClassRegistry::init("Foo");' >> app/Config/bootstrap.php
echo '$foo->User;' >> app/Config/bootstrap.php
app/Console/cake
```

The request for the User class, which ordinarily is considered optional, results in attempting to load the file `vendor/pear-pear.cakephp.org/CakePHP/Cake/Test/Case/Model/models.php` as the class `User` [appears in composer's classmap](https://gist.github.com/AD7six/b2f61da96a961027abee#file-autoload_classmap-php-L978).
